newsitem.title: GREECE: OTE TELECOM TO OFFER FREE TELECONFERENCING OCT 2.
newsitem.headline: OTE TELECOM TO OFFER FREE TELECONFERENCING OCT 2.

text.p: The Hellenic Telecommunications Organisation, OTE, said it would offer customers free teleconferencing services between Athens and Thessaloniki for three months effective October 2.
The service will be available in both cities at OTE's studios, it said.

"Teleconferencing allows users to communicate with sound and image from wherever in the world and avoid time difference problems, travel and related costs," OTE said. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
